items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: It was a Jo Jones trio featuring Tyree Glenn. We came in for one week and we stayed 17 weeks. Then the next time we came back in for 16 weeks, it was Tyree Glenn's quartet with the same people

ctx.x: I remember we stayed in the Embers there for a while with Joe Bushkin.

You know you went up and down the Street for one year, one block one year. I did a little house there with Dorothy Donegan and Joe Bushkin and Tyree Glenn. Of course, I had the trio there with Hank Jones, my original trio with Hank Jones, Tommy Potter -
